question: How far do the numerical differentiations of consciousness extend?
premises: Consciousness is contemplated as sixfold through the worship taught as the six vowels
It extends up to a twelvefold form
These forms apply in the creation of consciousness and in domains of equal scope
inference: The one consciousness unfolds into multiple ordered forms, from sixfold to twelvefold, within the same field of manifestation.
plain_english: It is sixfold through contemplation of the worship of consciousness taught as the six vowels, and extends up to twelvefold in the creation of consciousness and in domains of equal scope.
